title: MASTERMIND edge
description: A typed link between two nodes. The vocabulary is adopted from emergence's idea-edge schema, which had it right — most notably 'contradicts'. A lattice whose nodes can only RELATE cannot represent disagreement with yourself, and that is most of what thinking is.

type.description: related: distributional or tag overlap. refines: a sharper statement of the same thing. contradicts: incompatible with. implements: a concrete realisation of. spawns: caused the existence of. sequence: said immediately after. shared-tag: explicit conceptual overlap.

label.description: The words that carried the link, for association edges.

origin.description: Who asserted this edge. A model-proposed 'contradicts' is a very different claim from a computed word-overlap 'related', and they must never be indistinguishable.
